From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>

Subject: Monthly slab & purchase-gate confirmation — next steps

Jordan — thanks for taking time today. Quick written recap so we have alignment and an obvious path for procurement: 

Call recap (9/1):
- Primary use case: real-time clinical note summarization for triage and physician workflows.
- Expected steady-state usage: somewhere in the 8M–20M generated tokens / month band once integrated (peaks may be higher during pilot).
- Target unit economics the customer referenced: target ~$180–$220 per 1M tokens (they asked for a mid-point proposal).

Procurement question to confirm:
- Atlas procurement said PO requirement kicks in at an annual committed spend > $75k (procurement@atlashealth.com), and for anything under ~$10k/month they can use credit card/standard SSO billing. Can you confirm that threshold is still accurate?

Our proposed next steps (short timeline):
1) We will send an updated pricing appendix that maps expected monthly slabs to per-1M token price tiers, with examples for caching assumptions (attached: redwood-pricing-v2.pdf).
2) Draft a short Mutual Action Plan (attached: 1-pager-MAP.pdf) with responsibilities, timelines, and who owns the PO process on Atlas side.
3) If you confirm the $75k annual PO trigger and the 8M–20M monthly slab, we can bake a 10% pilot discount for the first 3 months and provide standard net-30 payment terms for the initial PO. Rishi (cc) will confirm final legal/finance gating items.

Deliverables I attached: pricing appendix (PDF), draft SOW (DOCX), MAP (PDF). Please reply with a firm confirmation of the procurement trigger and where you want the PO routed (procurement contact + billing address). If anything above is off, flag it and we’ll adjust.

--
Lauren Bishop
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks Lauren — helpful recap and clear asks. Confirmations from my side: 
- Monthly slab estimate is correct for our planning: 8M–20M tokens/month during rollout. We expect slow ramp over 6–8 weeks.
- Procurement threshold: our procurement team confirms that a formal PO is required when annualized spend exceeds $75k. For monthly estimated spends below $10k we can proceed on a corporate card or internal charge code while contracting completes.

A couple of asks from me: 
1) Can you show a worked example in the pricing appendix that includes a conservative caching assumption (20% effective token reduction) vs no-caching? That will help our finance team run sensitivity.
2) Please include an explicit monthly vs annualized cost row so I can confirm whether the $75k threshold will be hit based on the different projected slabs.

Procurement contact for routing the PO: procurement@atlashealth.com (cc'd) — please copy procurement on the formal quote. Billing address and legal contact will be provided once procurement confirms the final SOW.

I think the pilot discount + net-30 is reasonable; procurement will need the MAP to verify responsibilities and go/no-go dates. Send updated deck and I will push it through their queue.

—Jordan

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Monthly slab & purchase-gate confirmation — next steps

Jordan — thanks for the quick confirmation. A couple of finance/ops clarifying points before we generate the formal quote: 

1) Pilot discount: we can commit to a 10% pilot discount for the first 90 days (applies to usage above the free trial slab). That will be reflected as a credit line on the initial invoice — please confirm that procurement is OK with receiving an invoice + credit rather than an adjusted unit price on the PO.

2) Net terms: Net-30 is acceptable for Atlas for the pilot period; after the pilot we require either an annual commitment or standard prepay/advance for enterprise accounts that exceed the $75k annualized threshold.

3) PO timing & ops lead time: typical lead time from our side to accept a PO and map billing is 5–7 business days after SOW + PO are signed and we have the billing contact. If you need shorter lead time we can escalate.

4) Pricing worked examples: Lauren, can you add two sample rows to the appendix that show: (A) 8M tokens/month with 20% effective caching and (B) 20M tokens/month with no caching. Use our proposed mid-tier rate of $195 / 1M tokens as the baseline (pre-pilot discount). Jordan — if those sample figures look reasonable I’ll include them in the formal quote.

Jordan — final ask: please confirm the procurement email that will actually sign the PO (procurement@atlashealth.com is a group; we need a named signer and billing contact).

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Finance & GTM Ops | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
